books.title: Extraordinary Awakenings: When Trauma Leads to Transformation
books.author: Steve Taylor
books.description: Stories of people who went through bereavement, depression, addiction, combat or imprisonment and came out of it spiritually awakened rather than broken. Steve looks at the psychological processes behind these shifts and draws out lessons readers can use in their own hard times.

books.title: Back to Sanity: Healing the Madness of Our Minds
books.author: Steve Taylor
books.description: Steve argues that the restless discontent behind materialism, status-seeking and conflict comes from an ego-driven state of mind he calls humania. The book traces where it comes from and how moments of inner harmony can become a settled way of being.
